title: Mushrooms
body:
Description

Mushrooms are a type of Mushroom found in Uncertainty Cave found inside the Desert Canyons (Ferwater Island). (Also near the Lighthouse) They are found scattered on the floor of the cave. Unlike Mysterious Mushrooms, they do not shoot projectiles.

There are 4 colors of mushrooms. Red, green, blue, and purple.

Their caps value at average of 1500$.

If mysterious mushroom’s projectile hits chopped mushroom its cap becomes black non-collidable part.

Trivia

  • Sanded Green Mushrooms looks similar to sanded Kelp
  • Mushrooms become Corrupted Mushrooms when a Mysterious Mushroom spore destroys their cap, these become square when sanded.
  • Red mushrooms can be found in the lost woods
